name: Example Home Telecom Host

securitySheaf.label: Probe-2 Household Credential Check
securitySheaf.effect: A cheap household helper icon checks the decker's account, access path, and persona tags.

securitySheaf.label: Suspicious Access Log
securitySheaf.effect: The telecom records odd account activity and queues a notification for the resident or service provider.

encounter.consequence: The home telecom may notify the resident, landlord, or MSP that suspicious access occurred. Notify the GM if this remains unresolved.

securitySheaf.label: Household Lockout Warning
securitySheaf.effect: Appliance panels blink red and the telecom prepares to lock the current session out of private controls.

securitySheaf.label: Telecom Session Dump
securitySheaf.effect: The telecom drops non-resident sessions and tries to preserve logs for later support review.

encounter.consequence: Host shutdown/session dump. Resolve dump shock or clean disconnect effects as appropriate for the decker and connection mode.

sculpting: A household trid interface: public scrapbook pages, social posts, family photos, message frames, appliance panels, vidphone logs, calendar notes, cheap helper icons, and a locked domestic control console at the bottom.
notes: Generic SSG home telecom host for Mevin Decker Experience. Shallow Blue-4 profile with public social/profile material, private personal data, household device controls, and a final full host takeover node. All concrete contents are GM-fill prompts.

nodes.title: Known Home Telecom Address
nodes.description: You are outside a generic household telecom host. The public face is ordinary social/profile clutter; the private side is the home's personal data and device-control layer. Use this as a stand-in until the GM fills in the household specifics.

choices.label: Break into the private telecom host
Back away from the telecom address

nodes.title: Public Household Page
nodes.description: The public surface shows the kind of ordinary information a resident might leave visible: profile blurbs, avatar tags, public photos, family names, hobby pages, neighborhood links, and a few stale message-board posts.

nodes.title: Public Social Stand-Ins
nodes.description: You find public social/profile stand-ins. Tell the GM you have public telecom social data; ask what visible names, handles, hobbies, friends, affiliations, or careless posts fit this household.

report.title: Public social/profile data
report.detail: Mevin found public social/profile stand-ins on a home telecom. GM fills in visible names, handles, hobbies, friends, affiliations, or careless posts.

nodes.title: Public Photo Wall
nodes.description: You find public photos, room glimpses, event tags, pet names, visible school/work logos, and timestamp crumbs. Tell the GM you have public photo-wall clues; ask what the images reveal.

report.title: Public photo-wall clues
report.detail: Mevin found public photos and household visual clues. GM fills in visible locations, timestamps, people, logos, pets, room details, or other clues.

nodes.title: Neighborhood Links and Guestbook
nodes.description: You find public neighborhood links, guestbook posts, local service shortcuts, HOA/building notices, hobby groups, or old classifieds. Tell the GM you have public neighborhood-link clues; ask what matters here.

report.title: Public neighborhood-link clues
report.detail: Mevin found public neighborhood links/guestbook material. GM fills in local contacts, services, notices, classifieds, or social context.

nodes.title: Private Telecom Foyer
nodes.description: The public scrapbook folds into the private telecom shell: address books, vidphone logs, personal files, household calendars, appliance menus, and a deeper control console. Nothing here decides exact facts; every concrete detail goes through the GM.

choices.label: Search logs, calls, and calendar traces
Back out to the public page

nodes.title: Private Personal Data Hub
nodes.description: Private files hover as photo albums, message folders, bill envelopes, journal locks, chip-reader ghosts, and family account tabs.

choices.label: Private photos, journals, and saved files

nodes.title: Personal Messages and Address Book
nodes.description: You appear to have personal message and address-book access. Tell the GM; ask what contacts, call targets, saved mail, voicemails, or private handles exist for this household.

report.title: Personal messages/address book
report.detail: Mevin reached home telecom personal messages/address book. GM fills in contacts, call targets, saved mail, voicemails, or private handles.

choices.label: Log off with message access noted

nodes.title: Private Files and Journals
nodes.description: You appear to have private file access: saved photos, journals, work notes, school files, hobby files, or hidden folders. Tell the GM; ask what private contents are actually present.

report.title: Private files/journals
report.detail: Mevin reached home telecom private files. GM fills in saved photos, journals, work/school notes, hobby files, or hidden folders.

choices.label: Log off with private file access noted

nodes.title: Bills and Domestic Accounts
nodes.description: You appear to have household account access: subscriptions, bills, service providers, landlord notices, delivery accounts, and recurring payments. Tell the GM; ask what domestic records matter.

report.title: Bills/domestic accounts
report.detail: Mevin reached home telecom bills and domestic accounts. GM fills in subscriptions, utilities, service providers, delivery accounts, landlord notices, or payment clues.

choices.label: Log off with account access noted

nodes.title: Paydata: Personal Leverage Stand-In
nodes.description: You copy modest personal paydata. It might be blackmail, schedule leverage, domestic proof, a useful contact link, or just intimate context. Tell the GM you recovered generic home-telecom personal paydata; the GM decides the exact contents and value.

report.title: Generic home personal paydata
report.detail: Mevin copied modest personal paydata from a home telecom. GM determines exact contents, value, and consequences.

nodes.title: Logs, Calls, and Calendar Traces
nodes.description: Call records, telecom session logs, household calendars, wake/sleep reminders, delivery windows, and appliance activity traces sort themselves into domestic timelines.

nodes.title: Vidphone and Commlink Logs
nodes.description: You appear to have vidphone and comm-log access. Tell the GM; ask what incoming/outgoing calls, timestamps, saved callers, or suspicious missing entries are visible.

report.title: Vidphone/comm logs
report.detail: Mevin reached home telecom vidphone/comm logs. GM fills in calls, timestamps, callers, missing entries, and relevance.

nodes.title: Calendar and Schedule Traces
nodes.description: You appear to have calendar and schedule traces. Tell the GM; ask what appointments, work hours, school pickups, deliveries, medications, trips, or routine gaps matter.

report.title: Calendar/schedule traces
report.detail: Mevin reached home telecom calendar traces. GM fills in appointments, work hours, deliveries, trips, routine gaps, or other timeline clues.

nodes.title: Device and Access Logs
nodes.description: You appear to have household device and access logs. Tell the GM; ask what appliance activity, door/camera events, cleaning-drone events, or prior intrusion signs are visible.

report.title: Device/access logs
report.detail: Mevin reached home telecom device/access logs. GM fills in appliance activity, door/camera events, drone events, or prior intrusion signs.

nodes.title: Household Device Controls
nodes.description: Appliance controls, display panels, cameras, microphones, thermostat sliders, speaker zones, cleaning-drone hooks, and wireless node status lights hang from the telecom shell.

nodes.title: Camera and Microphone Access
nodes.description: You appear to have access to camera/microphone feeds or records. Tell the GM; confirm which cameras or pickups exist, what they can see/hear, and whether live control is possible.

report.title: Home camera/microphone access
report.detail: Mevin reached home camera/mic access. GM confirms exact feeds, rooms, records, and live-control limits.

nodes.title: Appliance and Environment Control
nodes.description: You appear to have household appliance, light, climate, speaker, or display control. Tell the GM; confirm exact devices and whether commands happen now, queue later, or only alter settings.

report.title: Home appliance/environment control
report.detail: Mevin reached home appliance/environment controls. GM confirms exact devices and command timing/visibility.

nodes.title: Cleaning / Service Drone Control
nodes.description: You appear to have simple household drone command access. Tell the GM; confirm whether any drones exist, where they are, what sensors they have, and what simple orders they can accept.

report.title: Household drone control
report.detail: Mevin reached household cleaning/service drone controls. GM confirms drone presence, location, sensors, and simple command limits.

nodes.title: Full Telecom Host Takeover
nodes.description: You take over the home telecom host entirely: admin control, private files, logs, and attached household-device routing. Notify the GM immediately. The GM decides exact devices, available data, resident alerts, persistence, and any service-provider response.

report.title: Full home telecom takeover
report.detail: Mevin took over the generic home telecom host entirely. GM determines exact data, devices, resident alerts, persistence, and provider/security response.

choices.label: Stay inside and review private foyer

nodes.title: Leave the Home Telecom
nodes.description: You fall back into ordinary Matrix traffic. Current-crawl lockouts are not permanent unless the GM says so; reset and retry after appropriate in-world time if allowed.
